name: scientific-illustrator-agent
title_zh: 自然语言直接生成可编辑的 Illustrator 科
tagline_zh: 不用再对着 Illustrator 钢笔工具较劲。说一句想法或丢张参考图，拿到的是图层、路径。
tagline_en: Skip the Pen tool grind. Describe an idea or drop a reference image—get layered, editable vector objects and live.
desc_en: Create editable scientific workflow diagrams in desktop Adobe Illustrator from natural-language ideas or simple reference images, using a bundled Python FigureSpec renderer and Windows COM. Use when the user wants Illustrator vector objects and editable text rather than a raster image.
why_zh: 它不吐位图，而是用自带的 Python FigureSpec 渲染器在 Windows COM 里直接…
why_en: No raster cop-outs. Its bundled FigureSpec renderer drives Illustrator via Windows COM, building real objects—text stays text.
limit_zh: 只认 Windows + 本机已装桌面版 Adobe Illustrator；参考图仅限简单示意图。
limit_en: Windows only, with desktop Adobe Illustrator installed. Handles simple schematic references, not photos. Output is a structured diagram—no aesthetic.
title_en: Editable AI workflow diagrams from plain language
